title: M3.2 AI Kit Factory design
purpose: Replace the previously contemplated Source-to-Draft pipeline with a minimal AI Kit Factory contract: strong AI authors directly from source material, deterministic code gates canonical/structural quality, and an independent AI reviewer gates semantic/source fidelity.
invariants: M3.2 is AI Kit Factory, not Source-to-Draft.
No generic source-ingestion or intermediate-draft subsystem is introduced.
A capable author AI reads source files directly.
Canonical validity and M3.1 pedagogical quality remain deterministic upstream authorities.
Factory structural PASS requires M3.1 STRONG or EXCELLENT_BY_PROFILE; COMPLETE is HOLD.
Semantic/source-fidelity quality is reviewed by a logically independent AI context under a stable structured review contract.
A deterministic gate verifies review shape, source/brief/kit binding, independence declarations and final PASS/HOLD consistency; it does not claim to prove semantic truth itself.
No model provider, network API, backend, learner-runtime or Studio document-ingestion dependency is added.
Human UX debt #272 remains separate and deferred.
M3.3, M3.4, Gate3, Gate4 and M4+ remain HOLD.
requiredEvidence: Factory context, semantic-review and final evidence contracts frozen.
Final gate requires deterministic structure plus semantic reviewer PASS; no scalar score can independently release a kit.
Exact ATLAS-WP-014 implementation and QA-WP-022 path sets frozen and disjoint.
adversarialTests: Reject design that inserts source/provenance fields into learnit.kit.v2.
Reject same active author context as semantic reviewer.
Reject factory PASS on M3.1 COMPLETE.
Reject semantic PASS without exact source/brief/kit hash binding.
Reject semantic PASS with a blocking or major finding.
independentReview: Linus architecture challenge recorded on authority issue #282.
Steve product challenge recorded on authority issue #282.
Pedagogical semantic-quality challenge recorded on authority issue #282.
Repository governance and PR scope gate the design PR.
rollback: Revert only the two design files. Promoted M3.1 product, stable Pages and learner runtime remain unchanged.
